immutable_selection_rules.repo_local: bind results to the repository base revision and tree
immutable_selection_rules.mathlib: use only the lake-manifest full revision and clean materialized tree; source identities are Git blobs plus SHA-256
immutable_selection_rules.external: resolve moving refs to a full commit and tree before classification; bind raw files to the full commit and SHA-256
immutable_selection_rules.negative_search: bind the dated query response or explicit access failure to SHA-256; no bounded no-match proves global absence

credentials_policy: Use unauthenticated public read endpoints only. Do not expose credentials, clone or fetch dependencies, update Lake, build dependencies, or mutate Formalizations/Lean/.lake.
network_policy: Network is used only for bounded read-only discovery metadata and immutable raw-source inspection. Candidate elaboration uses the existing pinned local toolchain.
expected_negative_evidence: HTTP or search status and bounded result count
response-body SHA-256 or explicit local rg exit status
credential, rate-limit, indexing, archival, and private-repository limitations
no discovery-saturation claim without independent review
candidate_fields_required: project, canonical remote, immutable commit and tree
module, file, source hash, declaration and exact type
toolchain, dependency revisions, license and local feasibility
normalized comparison with the frozen existence-nonempty-uniqueness target
checked wrapper versus terminal proof-body provenance
direct dependencies and known transitive boundaries
machine-reported axioms and foundation fit when locally checkable
placeholder, bodyless, unsafe, oracle, external-code, generated-artifact and unknown-trust boundary
smallest direct check, machine classification, integration decision and reopen condition
status_boundary: This protocol freezes a bounded formal-anchor discovery run. Complete classification of its inventory does not imply internet-wide discovery saturation, accepted proof state, AUDIT-Z, or theorem completion.
